title: Money Machines
intro: Ten "ways to get rich". One minute.
Swipe left for scam, right for safe.
A couple are just boring and honest!

cards.text: Rent mining power, earn 5% a day! Withdraw after 60 days.
cards.why: Fixed daily returns plus a withdrawal wait is a classic fake mining scheme.

cards.text: Staking rewards are variable, about 3–5% a year. You can lose money if prices fall.
Buy my €499 course and I'll show you my secret 10x method.
cards.why: Paying for "secret" get-rich methods is the business.

cards.text: Send NVL to this bot and it doubles your coins in 24 hours!
I just save a little each month. Slow, but I sleep well 😴
cards.why: A friend sharing a habit, asking nothing.

cards.text: Pay 50 NVL, recruit 2 people, they recruit 2… earn forever!
Guaranteed 20% a month, backed by real gold!
cards.why: Guarantees are the giveaway, whatever "backs" them.
Small, real and boring. That's what real interest looks like.

cards.text: Spin the crypto wheel! Deposit 20 NVL to unlock 10 free spins.
cards.why: Gambling dressed up as a prize, with a deposit first.

cards.text: Flip NFTs for €3,000 a week, no experience needed! Join the paid VIP group.
cards.why: Easy money with no skill, behind a paid group.

golden_rule: Real money grows slowly and comes with risks. Guaranteed, fast and recruit-to-earn are the warning signs.

options.text: A few percent a year, with risks explained
A bot that doubles your coins

quick_check.explain: Real returns are small and honest about risk.
